Well since it will probably be two weeks before you hear from Jon and I
have the some of these cards right here...

Lena Rowe: Lena cannot attempt actions that would give her a title and
cannot be chosen as the recipient of a title.

Shade: Retainer with 2 life. When the minion with this retainer is in
combat, the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution.
Superior: As above, but Shade has 3 life.

Scouting Mission: D Bleed with +1 bleed. Superior: This action is at +1
stealth. A younger, uncontrolled vampire gains 2 blood from the blood bank.

Sorry no Infernal Familar. Hope this is what your looking for.

--
Steve Bucy

Infernal Familiar doesn't have superior text.
Retainer, Infernal Familiar. Thaumaturgy required, and a 2 blood cost.
Retainer with 2 life. The vampire with this retainer can play a card
that requires a Discipline he or she does not have as if he or she had
the basic level of that Discipline; if he or she does so, place an
investment counter on the Infernal Familiar. If the number of investment
counters on the Familiar is greater than his controller's capacity, burn
the controlling vampire.
